summary: STMicroelectronics N.V., a Netherlands-based semiconductor company, filed a Form 6-K announcing a US$1.5 billion dual-tranche offering of senior unsecured convertible bonds (5-year 2031 and 7-year 2033 tranches) and the early redemption of its outstanding US$750 million zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2027. The new bonds carry interest rates of 0.00%-0.50% for the 2031 tranche and 0.625%-1.125% for the 2033 tranche, with initial conversion premiums of 47.5%-52.5% and 50%-55%, respectively, over the volume-weighted average share price. The managing/supervisory boards approved the issuance; BNP Paribas and J.P. Morgan act as joint global coordinators and bookrunners. Settlement is expected on or about June 23, 2026. The offering proceeds fund general corporate purposes and the redemption. The early redemption accelerates the refinancing of existing convertible debt, reducing net dilution risk. Watch subsequent pricing and conversion terms.
